db/acquisition#

What a pool gets from a connector: the connection and, when the driver has them, its preparing and transaction capabilities.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

What a pool gets from a connector: the connection and, when the driver has them, its preparing and transaction capabilities.

Public API#

role DbAcquiring#

role DbAcquiring

A connector may explicitly retain a second capability at acquisition. The pool never downcasts its portable connection to recover hidden methods.
